# Liliana Capor — licapor.dev

> Portfolio of Liliana Capor, AI Agent Engineer and founder of Tech Benders. She designs AI agents, MCP servers, and agentic workflows that put LLMs to work, with 9+ years building digital products.

The site is available in Spanish (default) and English (under /en/).

## Key pages

- [Home (ES)](https://licapor.dev/): positioning, featured work, clients, contact
- [Home (EN)](https://licapor.dev/en/)

## Case studies (Lottus Education — multi-tenant EdTech SaaS)

- [Sistema de Gestión Documental](https://licapor.dev/projects/gestion-documental): digital student records for 100K+ students; Bubble → React/Next.js migration
- [Sistema de Evaluación Docente](https://licapor.dev/projects/evaluacion-docente): faculty evaluation periods for 6K faculty / 80K students
- [Automatización de Titulación](https://licapor.dev/projects/titulacion): degree and certification automation, 75% faster processing

English versions live under https://licapor.dev/en/projects/…

## Expertise

AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, agentic workflows with Claude Code, RAG, LLM integration, React/Next.js, TypeScript, AWS.
